system.description:
You send out a detection pulse that reveals the distance and general location of non-crawler, non-flagged Mobs within range, giving somewhat complete information. Pinged Mobs hear the ping, but not its origin. Environmental conditions can shrink or extend the Spell's effective range.

Note: this pure detection/utility effect has no structural support - resolve by GM narration.

upgrades.description: If you know the Fear Spell, you may trigger it for free (no Action cost, though its Mana cost is still paid) against every Mob detected by this Ping.
Environmental conditions no longer reduce the range, and the detection information upgrades to 'mostly complete.'
Triggering Fear this way no longer costs Mana, and the detection information upgrades to 'entirely complete.'
